integrity: Brownian-bridge endpoint local-time law is classical; segment Markov decomposition is classical. New assessed quantitative statement is the factorized time-indexed cross-covariance profile, not the endpoint law or an independently audited novel result.
scientific_limitations: Standard zero-to-zero Brownian bridge, occupation-density local time and fixed interior times only. The weighted claim is for deterministic L1 weights. Literature may contain an implicit equivalent formula.
title: A factorized local-time–displacement covariance profile for the Brownian bridge
